units.source_text: 宇治山庄里也忙着准备迁居，向各处物色了一些容貌姣好的青年侍女及女童，人人笑逐颜开。

en.t: At the Uji villa, too, everyone was busy preparing for the move, selecting some pretty young maids and girl attendants from various places, and all were beaming with delight.

units.source_text: 惟二女公子想起今后迁居京都，这“伏见邑”“荒芜甚可惜”，心中非常难过，终日愁叹不已。

en.t: Only the second young lady, thinking that she would now move to the capital and that this village of Fushimi would be left desolate, felt deeply saddened and spent all day sighing in grief.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，却又觉得坚决拒绝而定要闭居在这山庄里，亦无甚意义。

en.t: Even so, she also felt that firmly refusing and insisting on shutting herself up in this mountain villa would have little meaning.

units.source_text: 匂亲王常常来信诉恨：“如此分居两地，深缘势将断绝。不知小姐做何打算？”

en.t: Prince Niou often sent letters complaining bitterly: If we live apart like this, even our deep bond will surely be severed. What does the young lady intend to do?
There was some reason in these words as well.

units.source_text: 二女公子心绪缭乱，不知如何是好。

en.t: The second young lady was in turmoil and did not know what she should do.

units.source_text: 迁京日期选定在二月初旬。

en.t: The date for moving to the capital was set for early in the second month.

units.source_text: 看看日子渐近，二女公子留恋山庄中花木向荣的美景，又念身如抛舍了峰顶的春霞而遥去的鸿雁，

en.t: As the day drew nearer, the second young lady longed for the beautiful sight of the flowers and trees flourishing at the villa, and thought of herself as a wild goose flying far away after leaving behind the spring haze on the mountaintop.

units.source_text: 而所到之处又不是永久的住家，倒像旅舍一般，这是何等失却体面而惹人耻笑之事！

en.t: Moreover, the place she was going to was not a permanent home, but more like an inn on a journey; how undignified and laughable that would be.

units.source_text: 因此顾虑多端，怀着满腹烦闷，忧愁度日。

en.t: For this reason she was troubled by many anxieties and passed her days in sorrow, her heart filled with distress.

units.source_text: 姐姐的丧期已满，应该脱却丧服，到川原去举行祓禊，但又觉过于薄情。

en.t: Her elder sister's mourning period had ended, so she ought to take off her mourning clothes and go to the riverbank to perform the purification rite, but that too felt far too heartless.

units.source_text: 她心中常想，也常向人说出：“我自幼丧母，记不起母亲面貌，不觉得恋念。

en.t: She often thought to herself, and often said to others: I lost my mother when I was very young, and because I cannot remember her face, I do not feel a longing for her.

units.source_text: 姐姐是代母亲的，我应该穿深黑色丧服。”

en.t: My elder sister stood in my mother's place, so I ought to wear the deepest black mourning robes.

units.source_text: 然而丧礼中没有这种制度，为此常感不满，悲恸无限。

en.t: Yet there was no such rule in the rites of mourning, and because of this she was always dissatisfied and grieved without end.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言特派车辆、前驱人员及阴阳博士到宇治来，以供祓禊之用。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, specially sent carriages, attendants to go ahead, and doctors of yin-yang divination to Uji for use in the purification rite.
He also sent a poem, saying:
